 32class InttegroClient:
 33    """
 34    Main SDK client for the Inttegro API.
 35
 36    The Inttegro client provides access to all API resources including orders,
 37    payment methods, payouts, financial accounts, and more. Initialize with
 38    your API key from the Inttegro dashboard.
 39
 40    Attributes:
 41        orders: Orders resource for creating and managing orders, processing payments
 42        payment_methods: Payment methods resource for tokenizing and managing payment instruments
 43        payouts: Payouts resource for scheduling and managing fund transfers
 44        balance_transactions: Balance transactions resource for viewing account activity
 45        financial_accounts: Financial accounts resource for connecting bank and mobile money accounts
 46        customers: Customers resource for creating and managing customers
 47        products: Products resource for managing catalog products
 48        prices: Prices resource for managing catalog prices
 49        refunds: Refunds resource for creating and managing refunds
 50        chimes: Chimes resource for sending transactional notifications
 51        schedules: Schedules resource for looking up and canceling scheduled chimes
 52        broadcasts: Broadcasts resource for looking up and canceling broadcasts
 53        otp: OTP resource for one-time password verification
 54        apps: Apps resource for creating, looking up, and updating applications
 55        spec: Spec resource for retrieving supported countries and currencies
 56
 57    Example:
 58        ```python
 59        import os
 60        from inttegro import InttegroClient
 61
 62        # Initialize client with API key
 63        client = InttegroClient(api_key=os.environ["INTTEGRO_API_KEY"])
 64
 65        # Create and process an order
 66        result = client.orders.create({
 67            "customer_data": {
 68                "name": "Akua Asantewaa",
 69                "phone_number": "+233541234567",
 70                "email_address": "akua@example.com"
 71            },
 72            "line_items": [{
 73                "type": "product",
 74                "product": {
 75                    "type": "digital",
 76                    "name": "Premium Subscription",
 77                    "quantity": 1,
 78                    "price": {"currency": "ghs", "value": 5000}
 79                }
 80            }],
 81            "billing_details": {
 82                "name": "Akua Asantewaa",
 83                "phone_number": "+233541234567"
 84            },
 85            "execute_payment": True
 86        })
 87        ```
 88
 89    Thread Safety:
 90        The client is thread-safe after initialization and can be safely shared
 91        across multiple threads.

166                base_url="http://localhost:8080"
167            )
168            ```

Main SDK client for the Inttegro API.

The Inttegro client provides access to all API resources including orders, payment methods, payouts, financial accounts, and more. Initialize with your API key from the Inttegro dashboard.

Attributes:
  • orders: Orders resource for creating and managing orders, processing payments
  • payment_methods: Payment methods resource for tokenizing and managing payment instruments
  • payouts: Payouts resource for scheduling and managing fund transfers
  • balance_transactions: Balance transactions resource for viewing account activity
  • financial_accounts: Financial accounts resource for connecting bank and mobile money accounts
  • customers: Customers resource for creating and managing customers
  • products: Products resource for managing catalog products
  • prices: Prices resource for managing catalog prices
  • refunds: Refunds resource for creating and managing refunds
  • chimes: Chimes resource for sending transactional notifications
  • schedules: Schedules resource for looking up and canceling scheduled chimes
  • broadcasts: Broadcasts resource for looking up and canceling broadcasts
  • otp: OTP resource for one-time password verification
  • apps: Apps resource for creating, looking up, and updating applications
  • spec: Spec resource for retrieving supported countries and currencies
Example:
import os
from inttegro import InttegroClient

# Initialize client with API key
client = InttegroClient(api_key=os.environ["INTTEGRO_API_KEY"])

# Create and process an order
result = client.orders.create({
    "customer_data": {
        "name": "Akua Asantewaa",
        "phone_number": "+233541234567",
        "email_address": "akua@example.com"
    },
    "line_items": [{
        "type": "product",
        "product": {
            "type": "digital",
            "name": "Premium Subscription",
            "quantity": 1,
            "price": {"currency": "ghs", "value": 5000}
        }
    }],
    "billing_details": {
        "name": "Akua Asantewaa",
        "phone_number": "+233541234567"
    },
    "execute_payment": True
})
Thread Safety:

The client is thread-safe after initialization and can be safely shared across multiple threads.

Arguments:
  • api_key: Your Inttegro API key (required). Get this from your dashboard at https://studio.inttegro.com/settings/keys. Use test keys (sk_test_...) for development and live keys (sk_live_...) for production.
  • base_url: API base URL. Defaults to production (https://api.inttegro.com). Override for testing or staging environments.
  • timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.0. Increase for long-running operations or slow networks.
  • transport: Custom HTTP transport adapter. Pass a requests.Session or custom transport for connection pooling, retries, or proxies.
  • telemetry_enabled: Emit spans to the configured OpenTelemetry provider. Defaults to True. The SDK never configures an exporter.
  • tracer_provider: Optional OpenTelemetry tracer provider override.
  • error_reporter: Optional application-owned callback for privacy-safe final-failure reports.
  • error_reporting_policy: Report unexpected failures by default, or use "all".
Raises:
  • ValueError: If api_key is empty or invalid

20    @classmethod
21    def _missing_(cls, value: object) -> "Currency | None":
